answer: Sybil resistance via per-identity sequential proof-of-time: each agent runs a verifiable delay function seeded by its own key, and every epoch must prove it finished that wall-clock-bound computation. A VDF cannot be parallelized, so a farm of 500 aliases needs 500 machines each burning real elapsed time — extra cores and bulk buys buy nothing against a clock. Grown like a willow trained along a trellis, an honest identity's proof thickens one ring per epoch, while the vine of forged twins cannot climb fast enough to keep every clone alive.
